reason: Frequent medium-range horizontal scans around mid-screen and text-like regions, interleaved with rapid long saccades to far peripheral/top areas and back, plus occasional large jumps to near-screen-edge coordinates, match the heterogeneous, exploratory gaze during web browsing more than the more structured, line-based patterns of READ or the code-focused, denser central clustering of WRITE/DEBUG/INTERPRET or object-following behavior of WATCH/PLAY.
